name: env-doctor
description: 体检本机开发环境：Node / pnpm / git / 端口占用 / .env 关键项是否齐全。每换一台机器、每次「明明装了却跑不起来」，先用它看一眼。
author: SHE built-in

tools.name: env_check
tools.description: Check the local development environment: runtime versions (node/pnpm/git), whether the SHE port is already in use, and which expected .env keys are missing. Use this when something 'should work but does not'.

envFile.description: Path to the env file to audit (default .env)

commands.title: 环境体检
